name: Mountain Estate, Breckenridge
lede: High in the mountains of Breckenridge, a newly built estate of about 10,250 sq ft lists heated terraces, a full outdoor kitchen and Bromic heaters among its outdoor spaces.
beats: A newly built mountain estate of about 10,250 sq ft, with resort-level outdoor spaces finished in charred-wood cladding.
In a ski town, outdoor living depends on heat: the terraces had to be usable in the cold.
Bromic heaters warm the terraces beside a full Hestan outdoor kitchen. The listing does not give the model, the mounting or the number of heaters.
